An '''arcade''' of stained [[Glass/Legends|glass]] windows and statues was a re-creation of monumental arcade from [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] that was located in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It honored the heroes of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]].<ref name="Complete Locations" />

==Behind the scenes==
An arcade that honored the heroes of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] was first mentioned in the [[2005]] reference book [[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']].<ref name="Complete Locations" />
